elsewhere.note: The sons of Reuben: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
These are the heads of their fathers’ houses. The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi; these are the families of…
Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
